summary: Our project is a game that helps school aged space enthusiasts to learn about hardware and machines left by NASA all across the solar system by providing a safe,thought provoking, somewhat challenging, cooperative, and above all of these, a joyful game.The game itself is not too hard however it is designed to keep school aged people entertained while they learn about these hardware left by NASA and improve team working as the game is designed to be played with three players.It is indeed possible to play as a single person but the difficulty increases drastically since you do not get all 3 of the hints you would normally get if you played with three players.
details: Our project is a gamified interactive solution challenge to increase the curiosity of the youngl people, esppecially students. It improves improvising and critical thinking capabilities with an entertaining way. It uses a multiplayer method to gather clues and solve the problem. The program gives you a real problem which happened during a spacemission and expects you to solve it. Once you typed your solution, the SI analyzes your answer and gives advices. Also it informs you about the real solution. We aim to reach a higher number of young space enthusiasts and improve communicative skills among children. The idea is compeletely original and belongs to us. We used SI only for main structures such as multiplayer and SI analyzes and then personalized evvery feature we can such as images, colours, sounds and fonts. This makes our project as creative as it can be. We prioritized a simple but efficient way to reach chilldren. We wanted a multiplayer game that children can both chat and concentrate on the game. We used HTML5, CSS3, Java Script as programming languages and Google Fonts, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Tone.js, Google Gemini AI API as other softwares.
